site.name: Hugo Mine
site.location: North Boulder Creek / Nederland tungsten district
overview: Hugo Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine on the north side of North Boulder Creek in Boulder County's Nederland-area tungsten district.

timeline.text: The Hugo workings formed part of the tungsten-mining landscape that developed around Nederland and North Boulder Creek.

moreHistory: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 describes the Hugo Mine at about 8,155 feet elevation on the north side of North Boulder Creek and records underground workings shown in a dedicated mine figure.
Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 places Hugo in the southwest quarter of Section 5, Township 1 South, Range 72 West and documents a shaft with levels at approximately 150 and 220 feet.

sourceReferences.title: U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 — Geology and Ore Deposits of the Boulder County Tungsten District, Colorado
sourceReferences.note: Describes Hugo Mine on the north side of North Boulder Creek and documents its underground workings.

sourceReferences.title: Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 — Tungsten Mines of Colorado
sourceReferences.note: Places Hugo in SW1/4 Sec. 5, T1S R72W and records shaft-and-level workings.
